'''Vladimir Yevseyevich Zuev''' ({{langx|ru|Владимир Евсеевич Зуев}}; January 29, 1925 &ndash; June 6, 2003) was a [[Soviet Union|Soviet]] and [[Russia]]n physicist, [[academician]] of the [[Academy of Sciences of the Soviet Union]], [[Hero of Socialist Labour]], [[USSR State Prize]] recipient, [[Honorary citizenship|honorary citizen]] of [[Tomsk]], expert in [[atmospheric physics]] and [[optics]].

== Awards and honours ==

* [[Order of Lenin]] (January 1, 1985)<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Зуев Владимир Евсеевич |url=https://warheroes.ru/hero/hero.asp?Hero_id=10585 |access-date=2024-09-30 |website=warheroes.ru}}</ref>
* [[Order of the Patriotic War]], 2nd degree (March 11, 1985)<ref name=":0" />
* 2 [[Order of the Red Banner of Labour|Orders of the Red Banner of Labour]] (January 28, 1975; May 13, 1981)<ref name=":0" />
* [[Order of the Badge of Honour]] (January 14, 1967)<ref name=":0" />
* [[Order "For Merit to the Fatherland"]], 2nd degree (July 4, 2000) and 3rd degree (March 10, 1995)<ref name=":0" />
* [[USSR State Prize]] (1985)<ref name=":0" />
* Prize of the Council of Ministers of the USSR<ref name=":0" />
* Honorary citizen of the city of Tomsk (2000)<ref name=":0" />

==Memory==
[[File:Akodem zuev.JPG|thumb|left|{{center|Monument to academician Vladimir Zuev that founded the Tomsk Scientific Center SB RAS and the created Akodemgorodok}}]]
* A street in Tomsk has been named after Zuev (Area "Science").
* There is a monument to academician Vladimir Zuev in Tomsk Akodemgorodok

==Publications==
The author of 32 books and more than 600 scientific articles. The main work in the field of [[optics]] and [[atmospheric physics]].
